CANTONMENT AREAS UNION COMMITTEES (CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 1966
CANTONMENT AREAS UNION COMMITTEES (CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 1966
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 21st May, 1966]
S.R.O. 461(K)/66.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by Article 89 of the Basic Democracies
Order,',1959 (President's Order 18 of 1959), read with clauses (2) and (3) of
Article 38 and clauses (1) and (6) of Article 39 thereof, the Central
Government is pleased to make the following rules, namely: .
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be called the Cantonment Areas Union Committees (Conduct of
Business) Rules, 1966.
2. Delegation of executive powers.---(1) The Executive powers of a
Union Committee, with regard to the following matters, shall vest in and be exercised
by the Chairman, that is to say--
(a) the execution of resolutions of the Union Committee;
(b) the conduct 'of the day to day administration of the Union Committee;
(c) the execution of contracts on behalf of the Union Committee;
(d) the execution of works by the Union Committee;
(e) the appointment, promotion, leave, transfer, punishment and removal
of the staff of the Union Committee whose pay does not exceed such limit as may
be specified by the Union Committee with the approval of the Controlling
Authority;
(f) the operation of the Local Fund;
(g) the custody, maintenance, inspection, development and improvement of the property vested in the
Union Committee;
(h) the acquisition, sale and disposal of property upto such limit as may be specified by the Union Committee
with the approval of the Controlling Authority;
(i) the receipt of amounts on
behalf of the Union Committee;
(j) the incurring of
expenditure on any single item, not exceeding such limit as may be specified by
the Union Committee with the approval of the Controlling Authority;
(k) the custody and maintenance of records of the Union
Committee;
(l) the issuing of notes on behalf of the Union Committee;
(m) the institution and defence of
suits, complaints and other legal proceedings on behalf of the Union Committee;
(n) the compounding of offences under the Basic Democracies
Order, 1959, and the rules and bye-laws made thereunder;
(o) the conduct of correspondence on behalf of the Union Committee;
(p) the custody of the common seal of the Union Committee;
(q) the doing of such other acts as are declared by Controlling
Authority to be executive acts to be performed by the Chairman.
(2) The Chairman may, with the
approval of the Controlling Authority, authorize subject to such terms and
conditions, as may be specified any member or official of the Union Committee
to exercise such of the executive powers vested in him and such official or
member shall, in exercising those powers, act on behalf of, and be responsible
to the Chairman.
3. Disposal of business.---The business of
a Union Committee shall be disposed of--
(a) in cases covered by rule 2, by the Chairman or any official
or member authorized by him; and
(b) in other cases, by the Union Committee at its meetings or at
the meetings of its subcommittees.
4. Meetings of the Union Committee.---(1)
Ordinary meetings of a Union Committee shall be held at least once in a month.
(2) The Chairman may, whenever he
thinks fit, and shall upon a request in writing of not less than one-third of
the members of the Union Committee, call an emergent or a special meeting. If
the meeting thus us requisitioned is not convened, the members concerned, may
move the Controlling Authority and thereupon the Controlling Authority may
convene the meeting at such time and date as it nay specify by a notice
addressed to all the members of the Union Committee.
(3) Notwithstanding anything
contained in these rules or any regulations for the time being in force the
Controlling Authority may direct that any matter specified by him be considered
by the Union Committee shall consider such matter within such period.
